note: Schematic roof model for Chiang Mai, derived locally from OSM footprints (ODbL). Roof forms and rectangular fits are assumptions, not measured roof geometry. Building heights reuse the input totals, which may come from explicit OSM height tags, levels times three metres, or a nine-metre extractor fallback; a total is not proof of measurement. Temple layouts and unmapped dimensions also use the declared compound grammar. Columns: lon, lat, length, width, rotation, eaves, rise, kind, group, category; kind/group/category index the arrays below.
